I am supporting Charlotte Nutt for state representative because I believe our community would benefit from having someone in Augusta who understands the Midcoast firsthand and has the experience to help address the challenges we face…

Last weekend, I drove Charlotte Nutt, candidate for Maine House District 48, as she canvassed voters throughout South Bristol. We stopped at over 20 homes and, time after time, I watched as she engaged in lengthy, animated conversation — with folks she had only just met — about their vision for good government…

…Charlotte grew up in Edgecomb, so she knows our community and the issues that matter to the people who live here. Her connection to this area is not simply political—it is personal. Charlotte is also a self-employed data consultant whose work focuses on building resilience for Midcoast municipalities…

…Charlotte is young and brings a fresh mind, incredible energy, and a deep dedication to the best interests of our community. Growing up in Edgecomb and spending summers on Southport—where her father became a familiar fixture in the boatbuilding business—she has deep roots here…

…Charlotte’s experiences living and working all over the world have given her the rare ability to connect with almost anyone and really hear their perspective - an essential skill for collaborating with 153 other legislators…

…In this work, she helps municipal leaders plan efforts in housing, transportation, economic development, and environmental sustainability. As she says, Maine, and especially the Midcoast has incredible businesses in the maritime trades, lobstering, and artists and chefs who make us who we are. She will work to support them In every way she can in Augusta…
